# Whether a loop closes, keeps or widens a difference

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`whether-a-loop-closes-a-difference` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](whether-a-loop-closes-a-difference.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A loop closes a difference only through a link that gives back less than it received. A return map below what it receives closes within d turns, exactly. With whole-number strengths a loop closes at once, keeps the difference or runs away: nothing between.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. A return map giving back what it receives keeps a difference; where every link gives on at least what it receives, the difference never falls below where it began, so a loop that closes a difference has a link giving back less than it received, found. (`Becoming.LoopReturn.returnMap`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.kept_of_identity`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.loop_kept`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.never_closes_of_no_less`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.closing_needs_less`)
2. A return map with f 0 = 0 and f x < x at every positive x closes within d turns and stays closed (an instance of Lasting.Variant.reaches), exactly by Nat.pred; a closing loop merges two differences and is not lossless. (`Becoming.LoopReturn.difference_variant`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.closes_within`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.closes_within_exact`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.closing_merges`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.closing_not_lossless`)
3. Taking a constant off leaves d - n * c after n turns, closed exactly from the least n with n * c ≥ d; a cut closes at once where every later link gives nothing for nothing, and is reopened otherwise. (`Becoming.LoopReturn.orbit_sub_const`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.sub_const_closes`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.sub_const_open`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.cut_closes`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.cut_reopened`)
4. Monotone return maps settle within d turns at a fixed value where f d ≤ d (exact) and never fall where d ≤ f d; doubling links run away, at least 2 ^ n * d after n turns, exactly for one doubling link. (`Becoming.LoopReturn.never_rises`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.never_falls`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.settles_within`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.settles_within_exact`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.runs_away`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.runs_away_unbounded`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.doubling_exact`)
5. With links multiplying by whole-number strengths, product 0 closes at the first turn, product 1 keeps the difference, product at least 2 exceeds every bound; no such loop closes gradually, while taking one off does. (`Becoming.LoopReturn.scaling`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.returnMap_scaling`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.whole_strengths`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.nothing_between`, `Becoming.LoopReturn.gradual_needs_another_link`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom; the difference is a natural number and a link a map of natural numbers; every law is stated on runs Law.run of the return map; the hypotheses each law names (monotonicity, f 0 = 0, links giving nothing for nothing) are hypotheses.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- A loop of Rejoining read as a return map: the difference here is one number, not levels at many conditions.
- That closing a difference is better than keeping or widening it; real strengths.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.
